title: Okavango Fly-Camp
subtitle: Eight Days in Africa's Last Eden
overview: An immersive fly-in safari into the heart of the Okavango Delta, combining luxury tented camps with remote mobile camping on Chief's Island and the Moremi Game Reserve. This itinerary gets you away from any crowds into Botswana's most pristine wilderness.
highlights: Mokoro excursion through papyrus channels at dawn
Walking safari on Chief's Island with expert tracker
Two nights in a remote fly-camp under the stars

days.title: Arrival in Maun
days.description: Arrive in Maun, gateway to the Okavango Delta. Transfer to your departure point and brief orientation before your light aircraft flight into the delta.

days.title: Into the Delta
days.description: Fly by light aircraft into a private airstrip in Moremi Game Reserve. Your first game drive begins almost immediately as the aircraft door opens — this is one of Africa's premier wildlife areas.

days.title: Mokoro Morning
days.description: Before dawn, slip into mokoro canoes and glide through papyrus-lined channels as the delta wakes. Listen for the plop of hippos, the call of malachite kingfishers, and the distant rumble of elephants in the reeds.

days.title: Into the Wild
days.description: Transfer to a remote fly-camp — simple but beautiful, with bucket showers, a mess tent, and an extraordinary sense of being deep in wild Africa. Walking safari this afternoon with our armed tracker.

days.title: Africa at Pace
days.description: A full day of walking and vehicle game drives from the fly-camp, covering different habitats and following the wild dog pack if it is denning nearby.

days.title: Into the Waterways
days.description: Fly to the inner delta — a landscape of open water, lily-covered lagoons, and palm-studded islands. Here boat activities supplement game drives, and the birdlife is extraordinary.

days.title: Final Full Day
days.description: Your last full day in the delta. A sunset mokoro, a night drive revealing the delta's nocturnal life, and a stargazing session with your guide.

days.title: Departure
days.description: Early morning drive before flying back to Maun for your onward connections.

meta.title: Okavango Fly-Camp — 8-Day Botswana Safari | Adventure International
